title: A man, a plan, a palindrome
hints: Compare from both ends at once: one index at the start, one at the end. You only ever compare letters, lowercased with `tolower`.

Inside a `while (i < j)` loop, first move `i` forward past non-letters and `j` backward past non-letters, **keeping `i < j` in both inner loops** so they can't run off the ends. Then compare, and step both inward.
`while (i < j && !isalpha((unsigned char)s[i])) i++; while (i < j && !isalpha((unsigned char)s[j])) j--; if (tolower((unsigned char)s[i]) != tolower((unsigned char)s[j])) return false; i++; j--;`
